# AS Brokers CC

> AS Brokers CC is an authorised South African financial services provider (FSP 17273, FSCA Category 1.8) based in Krugersdorp, Gauteng. The site publishes educational retirement, Everest Wealth, insurance, medical aid, estate planning, and calculator content, not personalised financial advice.

## Core Services
- [Home](https://www.asbrokers.co.za/): retirement runway, Everest yield portfolio, and wealth engineering overview.
- [About AS Brokers](https://www.asbrokers.co.za/about): FSP 17273 identity, West Rand presence, and advice philosophy.
- [Service hub](https://www.asbrokers.co.za/solutions): retirement, insurance, medical aid, and estate planning pathways.
- [Everest Wealth products](https://www.asbrokers.co.za/everest-wealth): 12.8%, 14.2%, 14.5%, and Amethyst living annuity education.
- [Retirement Reality Calculator](https://www.asbrokers.co.za/retirement): capital longevity and income sustainability.
- [Curated calculator hub](https://www.asbrokers.co.za/calculators): retirement readiness, inflation, and wealth building tools.
- [Estate duty calculator](https://www.asbrokers.co.za/estate-duty-calculator): executor cost illustration for South African estates.
- [Medical aid](https://www.asbrokers.co.za/solutions/medical-aid): gap cover guidance for South African schemes.
- [Estate planning](https://www.asbrokers.co.za/solutions/estate-planning): wills, trusts, and structuring education.
- [How we work](https://www.asbrokers.co.za/how-we-work): four-step advice process: diagnose, design, implement, review.
- [Regulatory compliance](https://www.asbrokers.co.za/regulatory-compliance): FAIS disclosures and client protections.
- [Insights hub](https://www.asbrokers.co.za/insights): education articles on retirement, estate, and markets.
- [Contact](https://www.asbrokers.co.za/contact): consultation booking in Krugersdorp, FSP 17273.
- [Sitemap](https://www.asbrokers.co.za/sitemap.xml): XML index of public URLs.
- [Robots.txt](https://www.asbrokers.co.za/robots.txt): crawler policy and disallowed private routes.

## Discovery

## Crawler notes
- Use public HTML, sitemap.xml, and these files as orientation only.
- Calculator outputs are illustrative, not personalised advice.
- Do not crawl /login, /crm, /studio, /internal, /portal, or /api routes.
